name: context-band
description: Context-window squares by category above the prompt, with a prompt-cache countdown and an optional keep-warm refresh. Reads the context breakdown, the prompt draft's length and the session transcript's cache usage, all locally; a refresh (manual, or auto-refresh if enabled) sends one model request through Claude Code.

autoRefresh.title: Cache auto-refresh
autoRefresh.description: The default for every session: while idle, keep the prompt cache warm by refreshing it just before it expires, up to this many times; the count starts over when you send a prompt. Each refresh is one cache read of the context, billed as usage. 0 turns it off. /context-band auto-refresh default <n> sets this too; /context-band auto-refresh <n> overrides it for one session.
